annotations.title: Token issuer controls: mint, pause, freeze/blacklist, seize, upgrade, roles and a holder's frozen status

description: Use when an agent must know what an issuer can do to holders of an ERC-20 (stablecoin, RWA, ERC-3643) on Ethereum or Base. Input: address, optional chain (ethereum default, base), holder. Output: JSON capabilities (mint, burn from holder, pause, freeze/blacklist, seize, upgrade, ERC-3643), matched functions, proxy implementation, role holders, paused now, holder frozen status and balance. Behavior: read-only RPC reads (bytecode function selectors incl. EIP-1967/ZOS proxy implementation, role getters, paused()). A function's presence shows capability, not intent; role holders may be multisigs or timelocks (signers not resolved). No contract at the address: 404, not charged. Code facts cached 10 min; holder status read live. Use instead: base_token_risk for a honeypot/rug-pull scan before trading; base_token_info for name, decimals and supply only; stablecoin_freezes for actual recent freeze events. Example: ?address=0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 Price: $0.003 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.
